markup.description: HTML/SVG markup for the 1280x720 stage. Give elements ids so draw(t) can address them.

css.description: Optional CSS for the markup. No @keyframes or transitions - all motion comes from draw(t).

js.description: Body of function draw(t) with t in [0,1]. Must be a pure function of t: no Date, no Math.random, no timers, no network. In scope: accent, lerp, ease, clamp, seg, and the fx motion library (fx.pop/appear/vanish/glide/draw/type/count/pulse/camera/op/attr/el, fx.seg/lerp/ease/easeIn/easeInOut/clamp).

caption.description: Optional short caption rendered under the stage.
